name: Brumal-Reliquary
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around acid rain regions, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Toxic air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Approach protocols for the automated beacon of unknown purpose are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
For traders, titanium and copper alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
